restrictions.title: Protected actions
restrictions.subtitle: Actions of this workspace that need a 2FA code or the approval of a second person.
restrictions.withoutTotp: {{staff}} staff member(s) and {{clients}} client login(s) concerned have no two-factor authentication: the actions marked 2FA are refused to them (they are invited to enable it), and they cannot approve.

legend.sensitive: = a fresh 2FA code of the acting user (through an access key or an agent: his confirmation in Approvals). Without 2FA the action is refused, with an invitation to enable it.
legend.restricted: = a second authorised person approves it in Approvals, with his own code (strongest).
legend.via: Surface: everywhere, only through the access keys and agents (REST, MCP, Claude connectors), or only in the panel. Scope: every account, or only / all except some accounts and sites.
legend.floor: Platform floor: set by the platform administrators, no level below it can be chosen.

restrictions.floorTitle: Platform floor: set by the platform administrators
restrictions.floorHint: Minimal level of each action in every workspace, whatever its own matrix (no reseller can lower it). Applies everywhere, every surface, every account.

scope.title: Scope — {{action}}
scope.hint: Accounts and sites this restriction applies to
scope.hintSites: A site matches when it is listed or when its account is listed. A batch touching one listed element is checked as a whole.
scope.hintAccounts: A batch touching one listed account is checked as a whole.
scope.emptyInclude: Nothing selected: the restriction applies to nothing.
scope.emptyExclude: Nothing selected: the restriction applies to everything.
